name: Kadhr – Boost Repeat Sales & Customer Retention for WooCommerce
author: kadhr

sections.description:
Kadhr connects your WooCommerce store to a customer retention system that helps you understand customer behavior and act on it automatically.

The plugin securely sends order data (customer name, phone, email, and order details) to Kadhr servers to support repeat purchase analysis and customer engagement workflows.

Short Description

Connect WooCommerce to Kadhr to analyze customer behavior and support repeat purchase engagement.

Features

  • Automatic order sync to Kadhr
  • Works with WooCommerce
  • Simple API key setup
  • No coding required

External services

This plugin connects to the Kadhr API to send order data for customer behavior analysis and repeat purchase engagement.

What the service is:
Kadhr is a customer engagement and retention system that analyzes order data to help businesses understand customer behavior and improve repeat purchases.

What data is sent and when:
When an order is marked as completed in WooCommerce, the plugin sends:
– Customer name
– Phone number
– Email address
– Order items and total amount

This data is sent securely over HTTPS to Kadhr servers.

Why the data is sent:
To analyze customer behavior and enable automated customer engagement workflows such as reorder suggestions, rewards, and follow-ups.

Terms of service:
https://kadhr.com/terms

Privacy policy:
https://kadhr.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin panel
  3. Go to Kadhr settings in the dashboard
  4. Enter your API key
  5. Orders begin syncing automatically
sections.faq:
What data is sent?

Customer name, phone number, email, order details, and total amount.

Is this secure?

Yes. Data is transmitted securely over HTTPS.
